notes: Clearway is a local-first customs clearance desk for clearing agents: job files, client records, live duty/MPF/HMF estimates, document control, status workflow, entry worksheets, printable entry summaries, CSV exports, and dashboard/report analytics. It runs with no server, build step, API keys, or external accounts; state persists in localStorage and is seeded with a 14-job demo workspace (ops@clearway.co / clearway123). Known limitations: browser-local data only with no sync or server-side auth; passwords are salted and hashed locally but this is not an enterprise identity system; duty/MPF/HMF figures are seeded operational estimates, not a live tariff database or legal filing; document attachments are not stored, only document metadata and references; no customs authority or broker network integration.
